say:0:1011701001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you feel now? Are you still dizzy?
say:0:1011701001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you feel now? Are you still dizzy?
say:0:1011701001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you feel now? Are you still dizzy?

say:1:1011701002:0.text: Let us know if you're not feeling well, and we can stop and take a break.
say:1:1011701002:0.source_cn: 倘若身体不适，我们随时可以为您停下脚步。
say:1:1011701002:0.male: Let us know if you're not feeling well, and we can stop and take a break.
say:1:1011701002:0.female: Let us know if you're not feeling well, and we can stop and take a break.

say:0:1011702001:0.text: Chippy just saw another empty Syndicate camp!
say:0:1011702001:0.source_cn: 满满看到了，旁边又有一座空荡荡的黑金营地！

say:1:1011702002:0.text: Something's off. I can feel an incredibly potent evil force up ahead.
say:1:1011702002:0.source_cn: 不对劲，我感觉到前方有一股极为庞大的邪恶魔力……
say:1:1011702002:0.male: Something's off. I can feel an incredibly potent evil force up ahead.
say:1:1011702002:0.female: Something's off. I can feel an incredibly potent evil force up ahead.

say:1:1011703001:0.text: What happened... The whole village is corrupted!
say:1:1011703001:0.source_cn: 怎么会……整座村子都被腐化侵蚀了！

say:2:1011703002:0.text: The soil reeks of decay, and even the nearby plants have wilted...
say:2:1011703002:0.source_cn: 土壤浸透着腐臭的气味，就连周围的植被都枯死了……

say:3:1011703003:0.text: Where are the villagers?! The Dusk Patrollers didn't receive any requests for help!
say:3:1011703003:0.source_cn: 原来村里住的居民们呢？！薄暮巡游队没有接到任何求助的消息！

say:5:1011703004:0.text: Look at the mess and half-opened doors... The villagers must've fled in a hurry.
say:5:1011703004:0.source_cn: 看此处屋门半敞，遍地狼藉。可能是在匆忙中逃离了……

choice_prompt:6:1011703004.text: Look at the mess and half-opened doors... The villagers must've fled in a hurry.
choice_prompt:6:1011703004.source_cn: 看此处屋门半敞，遍地狼藉。可能是在匆忙中逃离了……

say:8:1011703005:0.text: The ground here is exactly the same as the grape fields in Ryeham!
say:8:1011703005:0.source_cn: 这里的地表，和金穗村的葡萄实验田一模一样！

say:9:1011703006:0.text: Someone must've been performing corruption magic here for a long time... Maybe even a few years.
say:9:1011703006:0.source_cn: 一看就是魔法的效应……有人在这里进行过腐化……很久了。...

say:11:1011703007:0.text: So if we don't completely clear out the corruption, the places we found would end up like this too?!
say:11:1011703007:0.source_cn: 什么？你是说，如果没清除掉腐化，我们发现的那几个地方，...

say:12:1011703008:0.text: The forest, labyrinth, and even Lunadorf... would all end like this?!
say:12:1011703008:0.source_cn: 丛林入口，迷宫深处，还有月湖村……最后都会变成这种了无...

choice_prompt:13:1011703008.text: The forest, labyrinth, and even Lunadorf... would all end like this?!
choice_prompt:13:1011703008.source_cn: 丛林入口，迷宫深处，还有月湖村……都会变成这种了无生机的样子？！

say:16:1011703010:0.text: Is Eomir going to sacrifice the whole village just to accomplish his goals?!
say:16:1011703010:0.source_cn: 伊米尔……为了他的目的，不惜牺牲整座村子吗？！

choice_prompt:17:1011703010.text: Is Eomir going to sacrifice the whole village just to accomplish his goals?!
choice_prompt:17:1011703010.source_cn: 伊米尔……为了他的目的，不惜牺牲整座村子吗？！

say:18:1011703011:0.text: The most important thing now is to clear out corruption!
say:18:1011703011:0.source_cn: 比起想那些事，先解决腐化才是最重要的！

say:20:1011703013:0.text: We might be able to find some clues here... Even a little helps.
say:20:1011703013:0.source_cn: 废墟里也许还能找到一些线索……哪怕只是些许，也会对我们...

choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 我们还不知道他的动机

choice:6:0:1.text: The magic here is strong and dark.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 这里的魔力，庞大且邪恶
choice:6:0:1.male: The magic here is strong and dark.
choice:6:0:1.female: The magic here is strong and dark.

say:0:1011704001:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate showed up first, and then the wild creatures began to stir...
say:0:1011704001:0.source_cn: 首先黑金商会到来，然后，野兽开始骚动……

say:1:1011704002:0.text: I wonder if there are any other clues?
say:1:1011704002:0.source_cn: 不知是否还有别的线索？

say:0:1011705001:0.text: The purplish-black plants... That's when the corruption started!
say:0:1011705001:0.source_cn: 紫黑色的植物……腐化从这时就开始了！

say:1:1011705002:0.text: Eomir came to the village, but the diary doesn't mention him bringing any Thorned Guards...
say:1:1011705002:0.source_cn: 伊米尔亲自来到村庄里，但日记中并没说带着荆棘卫队……

say:2:1011706001:0.text: The villagers here had been plagued by corruption for days. Eventually, as the corruption spread, they had to leave their homes. The village ended up looking like what we see now...
say:2:1011706001:0.source_cn: 这里的村民被腐化烦扰多日；最终腐化扩张蔓延，他们不得不...

say:3:1011706002:0.text: Eomir knew all along but chose to turn a blind eye. He used the reputation of the sage to calm the villagers but allowed things to unfold!
say:3:1011706002:0.source_cn: 伊米尔早已得知，却无动于衷……以贤者的名望安抚村民，却...

say:4:1011706003:0.text: He is truly a disgrace to the name of a sage!

say:5:1011706004:0.text: Judging from the dates on the diary, the corruption started a long time ago... This may have been the first place to be affected.
say:5:1011706004:0.source_cn: 从日记上的日期来看，腐化发生在很久之前……这里可能是第...

say:6:1011706005:0.text: Things might've been different if the Dusk Patrollers had known earlier...
say:6:1011706005:0.source_cn: 如果当时薄暮巡游队能早些得知的话，也许事情不会进展到这...

say:8:1011706006:0.text: That rascal! What does he take lives for?! He and the Adamant Syndicate actually started corruption right in a place where villagers live!?
say:8:1011706006:0.source_cn: ——伊米尔那混蛋！！究竟把人命当成什么了？！他和黑金商...

say:9:1011706007:0.text: Does he see both the forest and its inhabitants as mere pawns to be sacrificed for his aims?!
say:9:1011706007:0.source_cn: 村民是丛林的子民！难道在他看来，丛林和人，都是可以被牺...

say:10:1011706008:0.text: Friends, regret and self-blame are of no use now. However, commencing action is still within our grasp.
say:10:1011706008:0.source_cn: ……友人们，悔恨和痛责，现在无济于事。但开始行动，还犹...

say:17:1011706010:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you trying to cleanse the entire village in one go?!
say:17:1011706010:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you trying to cleanse the entire village in one go?!
say:17:1011706010:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you trying to cleanse the entire village in one go?!

say:18:1011706011:0.text: Given your present condition... Your body might struggle to cope with such intense magic expenditure!
say:18:1011706011:0.source_cn: 你的魔力消耗……以现在的情况，身体可能会撑不住的！
say:18:1011706011:0.male: Given your present condition... Your body might struggle to cope with such intense magic expenditure!
say:18:1011706011:0.female: Given your present condition... Your body might struggle to cope with such intense magic expenditure!

choice_prompt:19:1011706011.text: Given your present condition... Your body might struggle to cope with such intense magic expenditure!
choice_prompt:19:1011706011.source_cn: 你的魔力消耗……以现在的情况，身体可能会撑不住的！
choice_prompt:19:1011706011.male: Given your present condition... Your body might struggle to cope with such intense magic expenditure!
choice_prompt:19:1011706011.female: Given your present condition... Your body might struggle to cope with such intense magic expenditure!

say:23:1011706013:0.text: Magister, Chippy may not know much about magic, but as your familiar, Chippy will support your decision!
say:23:1011706013:0.source_cn: 主人，满满不懂魔法，但是……身为使魔，我会支持您的决定！
say:23:1011706013:0.male: Magister, Chippy may not know much about magic, but as your familiar, Chippy will support your decision!
say:23:1011706013:0.female: Magister, Chippy may not know much about magic, but as your familiar, Chippy will support your decision!

say:25:1011706015:0.text: It is our mission to trust the magister and protect him whenever we can!
say:25:1011706015:0.source_cn: 无论何时，都要相信主人、保护主人，这是我们的使命！
say:25:1011706015:0.male: It is our mission to trust the magister and protect him whenever we can!
say:25:1011706015:0.female: It is our mission to trust the magister and protect her whenever we can!

say:27:1011706017:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if anything, use my magic too... I am your familiar, and you can draw power from me!
say:27:1011706017:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if anything, use my magic too... I am your familiar, and you can draw power from me!
say:27:1011706017:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if anything, use my magic too... I am your familiar, and you can draw power from me!

say:28:1011706018:0.text: I never want to see you in pain again!
say:28:1011706018:0.source_cn: 我再也不想看到你难受的样子了！
say:28:1011706018:0.male: I never want to see you in pain again!
say:28:1011706018:0.female: I never want to see you in pain again!

choice:19:0:1.text: I'm the only one who can do it.
choice:19:0:1.male: I'm the only one who can do it.
choice:19:0:1.female: I'm the only one who can do it.

say:0:1011713001:0.source_cn: 多亏帕瑞莎封存了她的传送法术，送给我们做应急之需。

say:1:1011713002:0.text: Let's go. We need to stop Eomir before it's too late!
say:1:1011713002:0.source_cn: 我们走，要尽快阻止伊米尔！

say:1:1011716001:1.text: Eironn and Lyca have joined forces with the outsiders to disrupt the sacred ceremony under the Lucent Tree.
say:1:1011716001:1.source_cn: 埃隆、莱卡等人联合外族，公然在流荧树下破坏神圣的祝祈仪式。

say:2:1011716002:1.source_cn: 荆棘卫士，还不拦下他们？！

say:5:1011716004:1.text: Ladies and gentlemen, I'm the captain of the Dusk Patrollers. This is a diary we found from a northern village. It was left behind by a Wilder.
say:5:1011716004:1.source_cn: 各位，我是薄暮巡游队的队长。这是我们从北方村子里取回的...

say:6:1011716005:1.text: His village has been corrupted and is devoid of life! Please take a look at this diary, it is written in blood and tears!
say:6:1011716005:1.source_cn: 他所在的村子已经被腐化吞没，毫无生机！请看看这篇日记，...

say:7:1011716006:0.text: Why doesn't Master Eomir come here anymore? Where are the Thorned Guards? Alas, I must leave... Farewell, my village!
say:7:1011716006:0.source_cn: 伊米尔贤者为什么不再来了？荆棘卫队又在哪里？我要走了，...

say:8:1011716007:1.text: I know you made a vow to take on the form of thorns and guard the forest when you joined the Thorned Guards.
say:8:1011716007:1.source_cn: 我知道大家加入荆棘卫队时，立下的誓言是化身荆棘，守护丛林。

say:9:1011716008:0.text: Tell me, why did Eomir stand by and watch our beloved people lose their homes to the corruption without intervening?
say:9:1011716008:0.source_cn: 那为什么，当我们亲爱的同族被腐化夺去家园时，伊米尔却袖...

choice_prompt:10:1011716008.text: Tell me, why did Eomir stand by and watch our beloved people lose their homes to the corruption without intervening?
choice_prompt:10:1011716008.source_cn: 那为什么，当我们亲爱的同族被腐化夺去家园时，伊米尔却袖手旁观，任由大家流离失所呢？！

say:11:1011716009:1.text: A Dusk Patroller and an outlander? I don't believe your words!
say:11:1011716009:1.source_cn: ……薄暮和外乡人，你们的话不可信！
say:11:1011716009:1.male: A Dusk Patroller and an outlander? I don't believe your words!
say:11:1011716009:1.female: A Dusk Patroller and an outlander? I don't believe your words!

say:13:1011716010:1.text: Why would Master Eomir corrupt the sacred Lucent Tree?!
say:13:1011716010:1.source_cn: 贤者有什么理由腐化我们的圣树？！

say:14:1011716011:1.text: Misarte bestowed upon us the Lucent Tree, a sight for generations of children to behold.
say:14:1011716011:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒将流荧树赐予我们，多少代孩子，都仰望着它渐渐成长。

say:16:1011716012:1.text: The sacred tree is eternal, but with the corruption spread throughout the entire forest, Eomir is able to corrupt the Lucent Tree itself and seize its life force for himself.
say:16:1011716012:1.source_cn: 圣树是不朽的，但是通过遍布整片丛林的腐化法阵，伊米尔可...

say:17:1011716013:1.text: Eomir has gained power, status, and your trust. However, he has reached the twilight of his life.
say:17:1011716013:1.source_cn: 伊米尔……他已经有了权力和地位，有了信任着他的你们，但...

say:18:1011716014:1.text: There is only one thing in the world that makes a man willing to give up power and fame...
say:18:1011716014:1.source_cn: 世界上，只有一件事能让人甘愿放弃权力和名望……

say:23:1011716017:1.text: Dear members of the Thorned Faction, please take a look at our Lucent Tree!
say:23:1011716017:1.source_cn: 荆棘，睁开双眼，看看我们的流荧圣树！

say:24:1011716018:1.text: Look at its roots, the spring beneath its shade, and the leaves that once sparkled like stars—what has become of them now?!
say:24:1011716018:1.source_cn: 它的根系，荫蔽下的清泉，曾经闪烁如繁星一般的叶片，现在...

say:25:1011716019:1.text: It's not we who corrupted the Lucent Tree, but Eomir, in whom your trust lies. I will no longer address him as a sage, for he is not a sage but a sinner of the forest!
say:25:1011716019:1.source_cn: 腐化流荧树的不是我们，而是你们一直信赖的伊米尔——我不...

say:27:1011716021:1.text: Yes, I am the Scion of the Lucent Tree.

say:28:1011716022:0.text: Now, I'd like to tell everyone what I heard from the Lucent Tree.
say:28:1011716022:0.source_cn: 而今，我要告知诸位，我清楚地听到了流荧树的声音。

say:29:1011716023:1.text: I heard its prayers tainted by corruption, filled with sorrow for our blindness, yet it persisted in seeking Misarte's forgiveness.
say:29:1011716023:1.source_cn: ——那是被腐化侵染，为我们的盲目和轻信悲痛，却还在恳求...

say:30:1011716024:1.text: Misarte above! Did you really hear the voice of the Lucent Tree?!
say:30:1011716024:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒有灵……！你真的听到流荧树的声音了？！

say:31:1011716025:1.text: Master Eomir... Is it true what they just said?
say:31:1011716025:1.source_cn: 伊米尔贤者，我们……他们说的，是真的吗？

say:33:1011716026:1.text: Nonsense! There's no such thing as the Scion of the Lucent Tree! In the name of the thorn, I command you to take them down!
say:33:1011716026:1.source_cn: 胡扯，根本没有什么流荧树之子！以荆棘的名义，我命令你们...

say:35:1011716028:1.text: Misarte gave us eyes to see right and wrong, and ears to hear the true voices of the forest.
say:35:1011716028:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒赐予了我们明辨是非的双目，又使我们的双耳可以倾听...

say:36:1011716029:1.text: Children of the forest, I implore you to see and hear the truth.
say:36:1011716029:1.source_cn: 丛林的子民，我恳求你们，澄清视界，倾听衷言。

say:37:1011716030:1.text: And use your weapons against the true enemy of the Dark Forest—Eomir!
say:37:1011716030:1.source_cn: 然后，将你们的武器对准薄暮丛林真正的敌人——伊米尔！

say:41:1011716033:1.text: Eomir, this is the last time...

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 伊米尔才是腐化的真凶

say:2:1011718001:0.text:
Cecia, why did you stop?
I gave you the power. You can't possibly lose!
say:2:1011718001:0.source_cn: 瑟西娅，为什么收手？！\n力量已经分给你，你不可能输！

say:5:1011718004:0.text: Our scheme has been revealed. We can no longer drain the life force of the Lucent Tree.
say:5:1011718004:0.source_cn: 流荧树的生命力无法抽取，计划已然败露。

say:6:1011718005:0.text: While I haven't obtained everything as desired, the coveted portion of power is already within my grasp.
say:6:1011718005:0.source_cn: 虽然没有完全如愿，渴求的部分力量也已经到手。

say:7:1011718006:0.text: Tell me, what reason remains for me to lower myself and assist a mere mortal?
say:7:1011718006:0.source_cn: 告诉我，还有什么理由能让我纡尊降贵，来帮助区区一个生者？

say:8:1011718007:0.text: Are you going to break our agreement?!

say:9:1011718008:0.text: Hmph, a hypocrite like you dare to command an immortal Graveborn?!
say:9:1011718008:0.source_cn: 哼，虚伪矫饰如你，也配命令不朽的亡者？！

say:10:1011718009:0.text: I'm done with your tedious farce!
say:10:1011718009:0.source_cn: 这场无趣的闹剧，不必再演下去了……！

say:1:1011720001:0.text: Lucent Tree... I'm sorry that we weren't able to protect you.
say:1:1011720001:0.source_cn: 流荧树……我们还是没能完全保护你。

choice_prompt:2:1011720001.text: Lucent Tree... I'm sorry that we weren't able to protect you.
choice_prompt:2:1011720001.source_cn: 流荧树……我们还是没能完全保护你。

say:3:1011720002:0.text: No... I only said that because the situation was dire.
say:3:1011720002:0.male: No... I only said that because the situation was dire.
say:3:1011720002:0.female: No... I only said that because the situation was dire.

say:4:1011720003:0.text: Everyone is so convinced that I am the Scion of the Lucent Tree. So, I had to use the title and Misarte's name to get them to trust you and Lyca.
say:4:1011720003:0.source_cn: 大家如此笃信我是流荧树之子、我生来不同；当时情急之下，...
say:4:1011720003:0.male: Everyone is so convinced that I am the Scion of the Lucent Tree. So, I had to use the title and Misarte's name to get them to trust you and Lyca.
say:4:1011720003:0.female: Everyone is so convinced that I am the Scion of the Lucent Tree. So, I had to use the title and Misarte's name to get them to trust you and Lyca.

say:5:1011720004:0.text: In the end, I used Misarte's name in vain and deceived my fellow Wilders, but I shall shoulder guilt...
say:5:1011720004:0.source_cn: 借用神的名义，利用大家的信任，说出了谎言……这份罪过，...
say:5:1011720004:0.male: In the end, I used Misarte's name in vain and deceived my fellow Wilders, but I shall shoulder guilt...
say:5:1011720004:0.female: In the end, I used Misarte's name in vain and deceived my fellow Wilders, but I shall shoulder guilt...

say:6:1011720005:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know there is little hope... But do you think you can cleanse the Lucent Tree?
say:6:1011720005:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know there is little hope... But do you think you can cleanse the Lucent Tree?
say:6:1011720005:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know there is little hope... But do you think you can cleanse the Lucent Tree?

choice_prompt:7:1011720005.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know there is little hope... But do you think you can cleanse the Lucent Tree?
choice_prompt:7:1011720005.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，虽然我知道希望渺茫，但……你有办法净化流荧树吗？
choice_prompt:7:1011720005.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know there is little hope... But do you think you can cleanse the Lucent Tree?
choice_prompt:7:1011720005.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know there is little hope... But do you think you can cleanse the Lucent Tree?

say:9:1011720006:0.text: No! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stop! You've used too much magic along the way!
say:9:1011720006:0.male: No! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stop! You've used too much magic along the way!
say:9:1011720006:0.female: No! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stop! You've used too much magic along the way!

say:10:1011720008:0.text: The Lucent Tree holds Misarte's divine power. Clearing all of its corruption would demand a huge amount of magic...
say:10:1011720008:0.source_cn: 何况是承载着弥萨忒大人神圣力量的流荧树。要彻底除去它的...
say:10:1011720008:0.male: The Lucent Tree holds Misarte's divine power. Clearing all of its corruption would demand a huge amount of magic...

say:11:1011720009:0.text: Your life could be in danger! I will not concede on this matter! Let's explore other options... No matter how tough it gets, Chippy and I will always be with you!

subtitle:1:1011714103:.text: and under the guise of the ritual, you're corrupting the Lucent Tree. Unforgivable!
subtitle:1:1011714103:.source_cn: 更假借仪式之名，企图腐化流荧树！罪无可赦！

subtitle:1:1011714106:.source_cn: 丛林各处的腐化早已被清除，你的阴谋到此为止！
